title.zh: Railway曝安全事件：部分密钥明文恐遭窃取，攻击疑似瞄准AI服务商
title.en: Railway曝安全事件：部分密钥明文恐遭窃取，攻击疑似瞄准AI服务商

current_state.zh: Railway 在披露环境变量存储遭未授权访问后，进一步向使用谷歌云服务账号密钥的用户发布密钥轮换、凭据更换、重新部署及云审计排查指引；该事件仍被报道为可能与 Swell DAO 管理员密钥疑似泄露相关。
current_state.en: After disclosing unauthorized access to its environment-variable storage, Railway issued guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to rotate credentials, redeploy, and audit cloud activity; the incident remains reported as possibly linked to the suspected Swell DAO admin-key compromise.

updates.title_zh: Railway曝安全事件：部分密钥明文恐遭窃取，攻击疑似瞄准AI服务商
updates.title_en: Railway曝安全事件：部分密钥明文恐遭窃取，攻击疑似瞄准AI服务商
updates.what_changed_zh: Railway 披露其环境变量存储中存在未经授权的活动，可能暴露了加密的以及可能明文的客户机密，促使所有用户轮换密钥，并暂时停止全平台的构建和部署。
updates.what_changed_en: Railway disclosed unauthorized activity in its environment-variable storage that may have exposed encrypted and possibly plaintext customer secrets, prompting all users to rotate keys and temporarily halting platform-wide builds and deployments.
updates.current_state_zh: Railway 披露其环境变量存储中存在未经授权的活动，可能暴露了加密的以及可能明文的客户机密，促使所有用户轮换密钥，并暂时停止全平台的构建和部署。
updates.current_state_en: Railway disclosed unauthorized activity in its environment-variable storage that may have exposed encrypted and possibly plaintext customer secrets, prompting all users to rotate keys and temporarily halting platform-wide builds and deployments.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Railway disclosed unauthorized activity in its environment-variable storage that may have exposed encrypted and possibly plaintext customer secrets, prompting all users to rotate keys and temporarily halting platform-wide builds and deployments.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Railway disclosed unauthorized activity in its environment-variable storage that may have exposed encrypted and possibly plaintext customer secrets, prompting all users to rotate keys and temporarily halting platform-wide builds and deployments.

updates.title_zh: 【Railway 建议用户排查谷歌云异常访问，并更换可能泄露的服务账号密钥】
updates.title_en: 【Railway 建议用户排查谷歌云异常访问，并更换可能泄露的服务账号密钥】
updates.what_changed_zh: Railway 发布后续安全指引，要求使用谷歌云服务账号密钥的用户禁用并轮换可能泄露的密钥、重新部署服务，并检查云审计日志与账单；报道还称该事件可能与 Swell DAO 的 swETH/rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露相关。
updates.what_changed_en: Railway issued follow-up guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to disable and rotate potentially leaked keys, redeploy services, and audit cloud logs and billing; the report also links the incident to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO swETH/rswETH admin keys.
updates.current_state_zh: Railway 在披露环境变量存储遭未授权访问后，进一步向使用谷歌云服务账号密钥的用户发布密钥轮换、凭据更换、重新部署及云审计排查指引；该事件仍被报道为可能与 Swell DAO 管理员密钥疑似泄露相关。
updates.current_state_en: After disclosing unauthorized access to its environment-variable storage, Railway issued guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to rotate credentials, redeploy, and audit cloud activity; the incident remains reported as possibly linked to the suspected Swell DAO admin-key compromise.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Railway issued security guidance telling users to disable and rotate potentially leaked Google Cloud service-account keys and audit for unauthorized activity, following its October 21 incident that is linked to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO's swETH/rswETH admin keys and malicious upgrade contracts that could drain ~2,500 ETH.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Railway issued security guidance telling users to disable and rotate potentially leaked Google Cloud service-account keys and audit for unauthorized activity, following its October 21 incident that is linked to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO's swETH/rswETH admin keys and malicious upgrade contracts that could drain ~2,500 ETH.
